Deliverables.title: Human in the Loop Part 1
Deliverables.description:
APP LINK:   

A queue of knowledge files generated by AI to be reviewed by Contractors. Contractors can 
Filter the list based on assignee, type of document, whether a document has been reviewed, and fuzzy search 
Open any document and view it in markdown or in raw text 
View and re-generate the research evaluation that discusses the points of improvement for the given knowledge file
Make edits that are retained by the system 
Add comments retained by the system 
Submit the knowledge file to deep research 

Administrators can 
Assign contractors to documents to review 
Delete records to be re-generated by the system

Deliverables.title: Human in the Loop Part 2
Deliverables.description:
A queue of updated deep research documents. These documents are surfaced to the retool app with chunks of an updated document separated by section, and upon assignment of the document by an admin, records are created in the Retool database that hold editable versions of those chunks. Contractors can 
Filter the list based on assignee, type of document, whether a document has been reviewed, and fuzzy search 
Open any document and view it in editable markdown 
View the generated summary of changes that itemizes where a change was made, what type of change, and a description of why the change was made
Make edits that are retained by the system 
Add comments retained by the system 
View the original document to compare content  
Submit the knowledge file to deep research 

Admin Users can:
Assign reviewers to records, which generates the correct records in the Retool db
Delete records from Retool to be re-generated

Epics.title: HitL 1 Queue Filtering
Epics.description:
User Story
As a Contractor 
I want to filter the list of documents to review 
so I can quickly find the records I need to review.
based on assignee, type of document, whether a document has been reviewed, and fuzzy search 

Acceptance Criteria
Filter based on assignee 
Filter based on type of entity (candidate, measure, etc.) 
Filter based on review status 
Fuzzy search 

Additional Notes
Epics.deliverableId: Human in the Loop Part 1: https://app.clickup.com/t/86ae9x8z3)

Epics.title: HitL 1 Document Viewing
Epics.description:
User Story
As a Contractor
I want to open any document in the review queue that is currently under review and view it in editable markdown or raw text, or open any reviewed document and get an un-editable markdown view of it
So that I can see the content I have to review/have reviewed in a readable format

Acceptance Criteria
Open any document that needs review in both markdown and raw text
If there is a parsing error for the markdown, the system gracefully shows the issue so it can be raised to development for resolution

Additional Notes
Epics.deliverableId: Human in the Loop Part 1: https://app.clickup.com/t/86ae9x8z3)

Epics.title: HitL 1 Research Evaluation
Epics.description:
User Story
As a Contractor
I want to be able to view and re-generate research evaluation that discusses the points of improvement for the given knowledge file
So that I can quickly and effectively review my documents, knowing what areas require attention

Acceptance Criteria
Intuitively view the relevant Research Evaluation whenever I am reviewing research 
Upon making updates to the original research file, I can re-run the research evaluation to see if my updates are resolving some of the issues found by AI 
I know when the research evaluation is finished running, and if there is an error, I am notified 

Additional Notes
Epics.deliverableId: Human in the Loop Part 1: https://app.clickup.com/t/86ae9x8z3)

Epics.title: HitL 1 Document Editing
Epics.description:
User Story
As a Contractor
I want to make edits to documents I'm reviewing, and have those edits be retained by the system
So that I can perform my reviews over a series of sessions and trust that my changes are retained

Acceptance Criteria
Save the deep research documents upon re-evaluation
When I re-load the evaluation, the updated version is the one that displays 

Additional Notes
Epics.deliverableId: Human in the Loop Part 1: https://app.clickup.com/t/86ae9x8z3)

Epics.title: HitL 1 Review Comments
Epics.description:
User Story
As a Contractor
I want to create, edit, and view comments on a given review document 
So that I can track the rationale for changes across a review process and keep notes that assist me in the review process

Acceptance Criteria
Intuitively find and create comments on documents I'm reviewing
Edit existing comments 
Intuitively find and view the most recent comments on any review I select

Additional Notes
Epics.deliverableId: Human in the Loop Part 1: https://app.clickup.com/t/86ae9x8z3)

Epics.title: HitL 1 Submit to Deep Research
Epics.description:
User Story
As a Contractor
I want to submit a document to deep research once my review is complete
So that I can contribute my reviewed documents as deep research documents for ingestion by the Elections application backend content generation

Acceptance Criteria
Intuitively complete my review of a document by submission to deep research
Receive a confirmation message that shows the version of my document that is to be submitted to deep research
Upon submission, receive a confirmation that my research has been submitted
View the submitted version under the Reviewed Documents queue, noting that the correct version was submitted and that the review record has successfully changed status 

Additional Notes
Epics.deliverableId: Human in the Loop Part 1: https://app.clickup.com/t/86ae9x8z3)

Epics.title: HitL 1 Admin Assignment of Reviewers
Epics.description:
User Story
As an Admin User
I want to assign reviewers to documents to review
So that I can evenly distribute the work amongst the Contractor team so as to keep the review process moving consistently and smoothly

Acceptance Criteria
Intuitively see who is assigned to what review, and see which reviews are unassigned
Be able to assign a reviewer to an unassigned record
Be able to re-assign a currently assigned record to another reviewer
If I am not an admin, I should not be able to assign anyone to any review 

Additional Notes
Epics.deliverableId: Human in the Loop Part 1: https://app.clickup.com/t/86ae9x8z3)

Epics.title: HitL 1 Admin Deletion of Records
Epics.description:
User Story
As an Admin User
I want to delete items from the review queue
So that I can start a given record from the very beginning of the process

Acceptance Criteria
Intuitively delete a record from the queue 

Additional Notes
When a record is deleted, only the evaluation and the review status in Retool is deleted. The underlying document is not deleted, rather it's re-ingested by the Retool workflow that creates the evaluations.
Epics.deliverableId: Human in the Loop Part 1: https://app.clickup.com/t/86ae9x8z3)

Epics.title: HitL 1 Permissions
Epics.description:
As a Contractor User and an Admin User 
I want the app to define its behavior based on my role 
So that I can know that only the people with the correct access can perform associated actions. 


Acceptance Criteria 
If a user is disabled or not yet created, they are not allowed to see any information or perform any action within the app. They will get a message prompting them to reach out to a system administrator
If a user is an administrator, they will have access to all actions, settings, and pages across the application
If a user is just a contractor, they will have access to the queue, but settings, assignment, and admin actions will be hidden and/or disallowed. 
If a user is a contractor, everything not assigned to them should be READONLY
